doc.title: Oscar Peterson interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995

title: Closing thanks
summary: Williams says the recording goes to the Hamilton College archives and thanks Peterson.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, one thing about it, you can always do it over or you can always improve it or embellish it or add things to it or delete in case you feel it’s too busy. You have all of those alternatives going for you. Listen I want to thank you for taking the time, which is our only gift, you know, the time to spend with us and this particular thing that we are doing will go in to the archives at Hamilton College, and future generations will be able to listen to it and glean from it I hope.
Yeah, I want to thank you, Oscar Peterson.
You don’t have to thank me, it’s my pleasure.
And I’m Joe Williams it says here in small fine print. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
